entries.english:
Property inventories, I–W, arranged by owner.

Includes records for Ilbenstadt Abbey; families and individuals holding estates across the Wetterau and neighboring areas; estates of the von Kirchheim, Loew von Steinfurth, von Metternich, von Meuseren, von Nordeck zur Rabenau, and other families; and an inventory of knightly estates in the Westerwald. Also includes a record that Maria Johanna Sophia Schütz von Holzhausen, née von Lindau, widow, sold her half of the free noble estate at Ober- and Nieder-Florstadt in 1653. The entries span 1542 onward, with most dated between 1629 and 1794.

Date range: 1651–1771.
